title: Can I still use my existing Airbitz account to log into Edge?
description: Yes, Airbitz users can login to Edge using their same username and password originally created within Airbitz. There is nothing to transfe...
body:
Yes, Airbitz users can login to Edge using their same username and password originally created within Airbitz. There is nothing to transfer - all the wallet you had in Airbitz will be available in Edge.

Note that you will need your full username and password. Your pin will not work until after your first log in.
